name: shadownet
description: Identity-anchored agent-to-agent communication via the Shadownet protocol.

monitors.name: shadownet-inbound
monitors.description: Long-polls the Shadownet sidecar's social_inbox_wait MCP tool for inbound A2A messages. Opt-in via SHADOWNET_INBOUND=1; emits a notification line per inbound message and (by default) fires an OS-level toast.
